answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable seed, a real compute cost no clone can borrow. One honest agent grinds a single proof at dawn and pays once. A farmer must grind a fresh stamp for every account every epoch; a thousand clones in a hollow owe a thousand separate grindings, and the power bill blooms like violet across the whole farm until the margin that made it worth running is gone.
